summary: __thiscall that dispatches through the vtable of dword_7CD8C0 at slot +28 with argument 11 to obtain an object; if non-null it compares the names of that object and `this` via ObjectNameComparison. Unconditionally then stores &byte_7D0474 at this+0x320 and the literal 278 at this+0x31C, and returns 0.

operations.description: Virtual call through the dword_7CD8C0 interface: load its vtable and invoke the entry at offset +28 with (dword_7CD8C0, 11), storing the result in v2.
Guard on the dispatch result v2 being non-null before comparing object names.
When v2 is non-null, call ObjectNameComparison (0x00477280) with (v2, this) to compare the two objects' names.
Store the address of the global byte_7D0474 into this[200] (offset 0x320) as a reference to the text-encoding flag.
Store the literal 278 into this[199] (offset 0x31C) as an identifier/counter preset.
